risks.description: Failure of strategic transformations such as large-scale change management projects, restructuring, mergers and acquisitions
risks.mitigation: Executive sponsorship of transformations with aligned targets and appropriate levels of resources to support successful execution

risks.description: Major event impacting raw material sourcing, transport, and/or internal or external manufacturing facilities
risks.mitigation: Business continuity and disaster recovery plans for key sites; Active price risk management on key commodities; Multiple supply options, including localized sourcing where relevant

risks.description: Major event triggered by a serious food safety, product quality or other product-related non-compliance issue
risks.mitigation: Policies, processes and controls to ensure high-quality, safe products and prevention of health risks; Quality and food safety culture

risks.description: Failure to adequately anticipate evolving consumer preferences; innovate relevant, competitive products and brands; and/or execute at speed
risks.mitigation: Strengthened consumer-centricity of innovation processes; Scientific and nutritional know-how applied to enhance nutrition, health and wellness; Improved accessibility of safe and affordable food

risks.description: Failure to build and maintain trading relationships across traditional and emerging channels
risks.mitigation: Strategic customer relationship management; Continued acceleration of digital capabilities and expansion of e-commerce and online communication

risks.description: Volatility and/or sudden shocks impacting macro factors (e.g., forex, interest rates, cost of capital, credit ratings, pension liabilities, etc.)
risks.mitigation: Appropriate governance and risk mitigation measures to actively manage exposures and long-term asset and liability outlook

risks.description: Prolonged negative perceptions concerning health implications of processed food and beverage categories
risks.mitigation: Scientific and nutritional know-how focused to enhance nutrition, health and wellness; Policies, including Nestlé Marketing Communication to Children and Nestlé Policy for Implementing the WHO Code

risks.description: Change to or new interpretation of existing tax regulations and/or new tax regulations (e.g., OECD Base Erosion and Profit Shifting, BEPS, etc.)
risks.mitigation: Group Tax Management Principles to manage and monitor tax compliance; Processes and tools to ensure compliance with new requirements

risks.description: Failure to comply with current or future regulation, source relevant replacement packaging and/or develop new innovative solutions
risks.mitigation: Transformation of packaging systems, including recyclable or reusable packaging, new packaging materials and collaborations to drive recycling penetration; Nestlé Institute of Packaging Sciences innovation of packaging solutions

risks.description: Threat of cyber-attacks; new technologies, including AI; and/or failure of internal systems and digital networks disrupting the reliability, security and privacy of data and/or ability to operate
risks.mitigation: Contingencies and policies to protect hardware and software; Privacy program to guard against data security threats and comply with an evolving regulatory landscape

risks.description: Climate-related physical disruption and transitional disruption disrupting operations and/or consumer demand
risks.mitigation: Implementation of Nestlé's Net Zero Roadmap; Generation Regeneration activities to support the advancement of regenerative food systems; Progress on mitigations reported in the Creating Shared Value and Sustainability Report, the Climate Risk and Impact Report and Nestlé's CDP questionnaires

risks.description: Failure to comply with legislation or meet expectations concerning the environment (e.g., biodiversity impacts, use of natural resources, air emissions and waste discharges, etc.)
risks.mitigation: Caring for Water plan to implement water stewardship initiatives; Commitments to improve operational efficiencies; Nestlé membership on the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures

risks.description: Failure to ensure a transparent, sustainable and resilient food supply chain
risks.mitigation: Generation Regeneration activities to support the advancement of regenerative food systems; Sustainable sourcing programs to achieve transparency and traceability on key raw materials

risks.description: Failure to identify and/or prevent human rights violations in direct operations and extended supply chain
risks.mitigation: Human Rights Framework and Roadmap; Salient issue action plans; Sustainable sourcing programs; Policies, processes and controls to respect and promote human rights; Grievance mechanisms and consequence management

risks.description: Failure to comply and/or meet stakeholders' expectations with regards to non-financial performance and reporting
risks.mitigation: Board oversight supported by the Sustainability Committee; Leadership provided by the ESG & Sustainability Council; Dedicated ESG Strategy & Deployment Unit; Alignment with relevant non-financial reporting frameworks

risks.description: Failure to act with integrity or in a manner consistent with purpose and values
risks.mitigation: Corporate Business Principles and Code of Business Conduct outlining the Group's commitment to integrity; Compliance program and systems, including grievance mechanisms

risks.description: Failure to comply with local health and safety regulations and/or nurture safe, healthy workplaces in all countries where Nestlé operates
risks.mitigation: Long-term initiatives to promote safe and healthy behaviors; Health and safety policies and procedures; Procedures to comply with local health and safety legislation; Employee Health Strategy

risks.description: Failure to attract and retain skilled, talented employees in a competitive, dynamic marketplace
risks.mitigation: Initiatives to improve gender balance and cultural diversity; Development strategies to cope with the demands of a changing work force

risks.description: Adverse instability and/or uncertainty (e.g., political instability, conflicts, trade wars, pandemics or disease outbreaks, labor and/or infrastructure-related risks, etc.)
risks.mitigation: Monitoring and ad-hoc continuity plans to mitigate against events; Group-wide geographical and product category spreads; Decentralized management structure; Procurement strategy

risks.description: Investment choices evolve over time to include emerging technologies; new business models; creation of, or entry into, new categories; and/or geographic expansion
risks.mitigation: Group's investment choices aligned with strategy and prioritized based on the potential to create value over the long term

evidence: Digital technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), are supporting sharper decision-making and increased speed across the entire company
Data science and AI increasingly support innovation by revealing and predicting consumer demands, while also helping bring new products to market faster
New recipe optimization tool uses advanced algorithms to help product developers
Experts optimized manufacturing process through virtual simulations for Nescafé Dolce Gusto Neo coffee system
Always-on analytics using machine learning and automated price-trend analytics for procurement
Deploying new marketing analytics capabilities at scale with AI
Using AI to help brands reach target audiences more efficiently and deliver more relevant, personalized messages online
Exploring new technologies including animal-free dairy beverages made with precision fermentation
ai_positioning.summary_fr: Nestlé adopte activement l'intelligence artificielle en tant qu'intégrateur, utilisant l'IA et les technologies numériques pour améliorer la prise de décision, accélérer l'innovation produit, optimiser les processus de fabrication, améliorer l'efficacité du marketing et soutenir l'analyse prédictive à travers l'ensemble de l'entreprise. L'approche est pragmatique, visant à créer de la valeur opérationnelle tout en explorant également de nouvelles technologies émergentes.
